posts.text: As jensen said gpus is way you go when algorithms are changing so fast. Not asics. Well, today my point (derived from jensen’s) about asics got invalidated. With the right flow, asics can be a great solution for inference. And that flow is Taalas foundry now. The fact that they can ‘bake’ an asic at couple of layers (instead of the costly base layer) and combined with the proven tokens/sec numbers of 14000, this is a compelling sell.
